name: Customer Journey Tracking & Process Mining
description: Plane 2 of the CXOS Journey Triad — empirical, descriptive telemetry and process mining of what DID actually happen across time, channels, bots, and human agents: event-log stitching, actual path discovery, planned-vs-actual conformance checking, path drift vectors, channel ping-pong and loop detection, silent drop-off attribution, and repeat-contact root-cause correlation.
roleInCenter: Empirical reality engine: reconstructs stitched cross-channel event traces from raw telemetry, discovers actual customer paths via process mining, and quantifies conformance drift against Plane 1 (journey_mapping) blueprints so Plane 3 (journey_orchestration) can intervene.

glossary.definition: Time-ordered, identity-resolved sequence of all digital events, bot turns, queue waits, A2A delegations, and agent interactions belonging to a single customer goal episode
Algorithmic reconstruction of the actual directed graph of customer transitions, probabilities, and dwell times directly from stitched production event logs
Quantitative divergence metric comparing the empirical process-mined journey trace against the Plane 1 normative Golden Path blueprint across stage order, latency, and channel hops
Pathological journey pattern where a customer bounces repeatedly between channels or queues (such as web to chat to voice and back to web) without advancing toward resolution
Unresolved termination where a customer abandons a digital flow, bot session, or hold queue and does not re-engage within the recovery window, indicating latent dissatisfaction or churn risk
Frequently observed empirical route by which customers or agents bypass broken self-service menus or formal routing rules (such as zeroing out of IVR or using ad-hoc internal transfers)
Probabilistic and semantic linking of two or more contacts from the same customer within a rolling window (such as 24 hours or 7 days) to the same unresolved underlying Job-to-be-Done
Process-mined stage or transition edge exhibiting disproportionate p90 elapsed wait or handling time that violates Plane 1 stage SLA budgets
Measured handle-time inflation and sentiment drop caused when a channel switch or transfer fails to propagate the omnichannel context envelope, forcing the customer to repeat information
Contacts scored by siloed IVR or bot telemetry as 'contained' because no immediate live transfer occurred, but which trigger an inbound call or chat on the same issue within hours
Rate at which acoustic or lexical customer sentiment deteriorates across successive touchpoints, transfers, and bot turns within a single stitched journey trace
Information-theoretic measure of dispersion across discovered path variants for a given intent; high entropy indicates chaotic, unpredictable customer experiences

facets.name: Event Ingestion & Trace Reconstruction
facets.description: Data engineering and identity-resolution pipelines that assemble fragmented multi-system logs into unified customer journey episodes

children.name: Identity Resolution & Temporal Alignment
children.description: Correlating anonymous, authenticated, and telephony identifiers across distributed clocks

children.name: Cross-System Identity Correlation Keys
children.description: Deterministic and probabilistic graph linking web session cookies, CRM customer IDs, ANI phone numbers, and context envelope IDs

children.name: Temporal Ordering & Clock-Skew Normalization
children.description: Sub-second monotonic event sequencing across cloud telephony, CRM webhooks, and mobile client telemetry

children.name: Retroactive Anonymous-to-Known Binding
children.description: Back-stitching pre-login help-center browsing and failed web flows onto the customer record once authentication occurs

children.name: Episode Clustering & Multi-Actor Span Linking
children.description: Grouping discrete contact events into coherent goal-driven journey instances

children.name: Intent-Window Episode Clustering
children.description: Dynamic boundary detection that groups multi-day touchpoints into one journey episode until true resolution occurs

children.name: Multi-Actor A2A & Human Span Linking
children.description: Distributed tracing spans capturing orchestrator bots, specialist A2A agents, and live human transfer legs in a single causal tree

facets.name: Conformance Checking & Path Drift Analysis
facets.description: Algorithmic alignment of discovered empirical traces against Plane 1 prescriptive journey blueprints

children.name: Structural Path Conformance & Fitness
children.description: Token-replay and trace-alignment algorithms measuring adherence to planned stage sequences

children.name: Golden Path Trace Fitness Score
children.description: Normalized 0-to-1 alignment score measuring how closely empirical journeys follow the Plane 1 Golden Path

children.name: Skipped Mandatory Stage Detection
children.description: Identifies traces where required authentication, disclosure, or triage stages were bypassed

children.name: Unexpected Detour & Shadow Branch Mining
children.description: Surfaces high-volume unplanned stage transitions not modeled in the prescriptive blueprint

children.name: Budget Overrun & Trajectory Drift
children.description: Comparing empirical latency, effort, and sentiment curves against Plane 1 normative budgets

children.name: Stage SLA Budget Overrun Attribution
children.description: Pinpoints which frontstage wait or backstage API dependency caused a stage latency ceiling breach

children.name: Expected-vs-Actual Emotion Divergence
children.description: Detects stages where observed customer sentiment drops sharply below the Plane 1 expected emotion trajectory

facets.name: Empirical Journey Pathologies
facets.description: Catalog of recurring high-friction journey anti-patterns automatically classified by Plane 2 process mining

children.name: Self-Service & Escalation Cascade Pathologies
children.description: Failures at the boundary between automated self-service and human assistance

children.name: Self-Service Containment Loop-Back
children.description: Customer cycles through IVR or CAI menus three or more times without slot progression

children.name: Web-to-IVR-to-Agent Escalation Cascade
children.description: Three-stage escalation where digital failure leads to IVR re-triage and then unhydrated agent queueing

children.name: Dead-End Stage Abandonment
children.description: High concentration of customer drop-offs immediately following a confusing prompt, error screen, or hold spike

children.name: Transfer Pinball & Repeat Relapse Pathologies
children.description: Post-contact and multi-transfer failures that inflate contact volume and destroy trust

children.name: Multi-Hop Ping-Pong Transfer Chain
children.description: Contact transferred across three or more agent queues, including return transfers to the originating skill

children.name: 7-Day Repeat-Contact Relapse
children.description: Customer re-initiates contact on the same underlying intent within 7 days of an apparent resolution wrap code

facets.name: True Outcome & Root-Cause Analytics
facets.description: End-to-end journey economics, true multi-touch resolution accounting, and closed-loop feedback to Plane 1 and Plane 3

children.name: True Resolution & Journey Economics
children.description: Evaluating performance at the complete journey episode level rather than isolated contact segments

children.name: True Journey FCR vs Channel FCR
children.description: Reconciles optimistic single-channel FCR against cross-channel repeat contacts over the full episode window

children.name: Cumulative Cost-per-Journey Accumulation
children.description: Sums all bot turns, telephony minutes, A2A compute tokens, and multi-touch agent handle times per resolved journey

children.name: Churn Survival & Blueprint Feedback Loops
children.description: Translating empirical path defects into retention risk models and Plane 1 blueprint updates

children.name: Friction-to-Churn Hazard Modeling
children.description: Quantifies how specific journey pathologies (such as false containment or 3+ transfers) elevate 90-day churn hazard

children.name: Automated Blueprint Recalibration Proposal
children.description: Generates structured change recommendations for Plane 1 stage budgets and Plane 3 intervention triggers

metrics.name: Empirical Cross-Channel Journey FCR Rate
metrics.definition: Percentage of stitched customer journey episodes fully resolved in a single interaction without any same-intent repeat contact across any channel within 7 days

metrics.name: Verified Non-Leaking Containment Rate
metrics.definition: Share of self-service journeys (web, IVR, CAI) that complete without live agent transfer AND without false-containment repeat contact within 24 hours

metrics.name: Golden Path & Stage SLA Conformance Rate
metrics.definition: Percentage of observed customer journeys that conform to their Plane 1 blueprint stage sequence and complete within cumulative stage SLA budgets

metrics.name: Cumulative Multi-Stage Journey Wait Time
metrics.definition: Total customer wait and hold time accumulated across all queue entries, transfers, and asynchronous delays within a stitched journey episode

metrics.name: Cumulative Multi-Touch Journey Handle Time
metrics.definition: Sum of all live agent and assisted handling durations across every touchpoint and repeat contact belonging to the same journey episode

metrics.name: Pathological Loop & Repeat Contact Volume
metrics.definition: Total inbound contacts generated by cross-channel ping-pong loops, false containment leaks, and 7-day repeat relapses

metrics.name: End-of-Journey Episode CSAT
metrics.definition: Customer satisfaction score attributed to the complete stitched journey trace rather than only the final handling agent

scoringModel.name: Journey Conformance & Empirical Path Health Scorecard
scoringModel.note: Evaluates the empirical health of a live customer journey cohort in Plane 2 by measuring trace stitch completeness, conformance to Plane 1 blueprints, and absence of multi-touch pathologies.

dimensions.name: Cross-Channel Trace Stitching Integrity
dimensions.description: Completeness and temporal accuracy of identity-resolved event stitching across web, mobile, IVR, CAI, A2A, and ACD systems
sampleCriteria: Links pre-authentication digital struggle events to subsequent inbound voice or chat contacts
Normalizes clock skew across telemetry sources to preserve causal stage ordering
Captures A2A specialist delegations and context envelope handoffs as linked child spans

dimensions.name: Plane 1 Blueprint Conformance & Fitness
dimensions.description: Degree to which empirical customer traces follow the prescriptive Golden Path or approved fallback branches within stage SLA budgets
sampleCriteria: High trace fitness score against versioned Plane 1 journey blueprint
Zero unauthorized bypasses of mandatory identity or compliance stages
Stage transition latencies remain within Plane 1 stage SLA ceilings

dimensions.name: True Containment Integrity & Multi-Touch FCR
dimensions.description: Freedom from false self-service containment leaks and 7-day repeat-contact relapses on the same customer Job-to-be-Done
sampleCriteria: Audits all IVR and CAI contained sessions against 24-hour cross-channel callback logs
Reconciles agent wrap-up dispositions against 7-day repeat contact recurrence
Quantifies context reset penalties when omnichannel continuity tokens drop

dimensions.name: Loop, Ping-Pong & Silent Drop-Off Freedom
dimensions.description: Low incidence of channel ping-pong loops, multi-hop transfer chains, and silent mid-journey abandonments
sampleCriteria: Detects and flags self-service loop-backs and 3+ hop transfer chains
Attributes silent mid-journey drop-offs to specific friction stages
Tracks multi-touch sentiment degradation slope across transfers

dimensions.name: Plane 1 & Plane 3 Actionability
dimensions.description: Speed and precision with which discovered drift and bottleneck signals feed Plane 3 live interceptors and Plane 1 blueprint updates
sampleCriteria: Streams real-time conformance drift alerts to Plane 3 orchestration engine
Publishes ranked root-cause pathology reports to Plane 1 blueprint owners

failureModes.name: Siloed Channel Myopia (Mirage Containment)
failureModes.signal: IVR or bot team celebrates 80% self-service containment while ACD call volume rises because 60% of 'contained' customers call back within 2 hours via a different menu option
failureModes.mitigation: Replace single-session containment metrics with Plane 2 stitched 24-hour non-leaking containment accounting

failureModes.name: Unstitched Anonymous Web Pre-History
failureModes.signal: Process mining treats inbound voice calls as journey start node 1, missing the 15 minutes of failed web checkout and help-article looping that actually caused the call
failureModes.mitigation: Implement retroactive anonymous-to-known session binding using login events, continuity tokens, and probabilistic device-to-ANI correlation

failureModes.name: Survivorship Bias in Survey Attribution
failureModes.signal: Journey health appears green because post-call CSAT surveys only sample customers who survived queues and completed handling, ignoring silent mid-journey drop-offs
failureModes.mitigation: Combine VOC survey scores with Plane 2 silent drop-off rates and speech analytics sentiment on abandoned or transferred legs

failureModes.name: Cross-System Event Timestamp Skew
failureModes.signal: Discovered process graphs show impossible backward transitions (such as CRM wrap-up occurring before ACD call arrival) due to unsynchronized system clocks or batch log delays
failureModes.mitigation: Enforce NTP clock discipline, ingest logical sequence numbers from the context envelope, and distinguish event occurrence time from ingestion time

failureModes.name: Confounding Repeat Contacts as Independent Journeys
failureModes.signal: Five contacts from the same customer over 4 days are logged as five fast, successful journeys instead of one broken 4-day ordeal
failureModes.mitigation: Apply semantic intent similarity and rolling 7-day episode clustering to bind repeat contacts into a single longitudinal journey trace

failureModes.name: Alert Fatigue on Benign Path Variants
failureModes.signal: Process mining flags thousands of minor customer navigation variations as conformance violations, burying severe dead-end loops and compliance skips
failureModes.mitigation: Weight conformance drift alerts by downstream impact on CSAT, handle-time penalty, compliance risk, and repeat-contact probability

stateVariables.description: Real-time 16-dimensional empirical state vector reconstructed via streaming Kalman-Bucy filtering over raw omnichannel clickstreams, voice acoustics, ACD queues, and A2A spans
Instantaneous Riemannian Mahalanobis distance between the live empirical trajectory z(t) and the Plane 1 Golden Attractor Tube (mu_star(tau_t), Sigma_star(tau_t))
Continuous local Lyapunov exponent measuring whether the customer trajectory is converging toward resolution (lambda_Lyap < 0) or diverging into chaotic ping-pong and abandonment (lambda_Lyap > 0)
Instantaneous Cox proportional hazard intensity of silent mid-journey drop-off or 7-day repeat relapse conditioned on accumulated drift, wait time, and sentiment slope
Continuous 2-Wasserstein optimal transport distance between the empirical population density rho_emp(z, t) and the normative Plane 1 blueprint density rho_star(z, t)

differentialEquations.name: Empirical Journey Trajectory Ito-Langevin SDE
differentialEquations.formula: dz(t) = f_emp(z(t), u(t)) * dt + Sigma_noise(z(t)) * dW(t) + J_jump * dN_event(t)
differentialEquations.interpretation: Models the live customer journey as a continuous jump-diffusion process combining deterministic stage progression f_emp, continuous sentiment and wait fluctuations dW(t), and discrete channel or transfer impulses dN_event(t)

differentialEquations.name: Continuous Golden-Tube Mahalanobis Conformance Metric
differentialEquations.formula: D_M(z(t), tau_t) = sqrt( (z(t) - mu_star(tau_t))^T * Sigma_star(tau_t)^(-1) * (z(t) - mu_star(tau_t)) )
differentialEquations.interpretation: Replaces brittle discrete token-replay checks with a smooth, differentiable conformance drift scalar evaluated at every streaming event arrival

differentialEquations.name: Population Journey Flow Fokker-Planck Conservation PDE
differentialEquations.formula: d_t rho(z, t) = -div( rho(z, t) * v_flow(z, t) ) + 0.5 * Tr( D_diff * Hessian(rho(z, t)) ) - h_drop(z, t) * rho(z, t)
differentialEquations.interpretation: Tracks millions of concurrent journeys as a continuous Eulerian probability fluid rho(z, t), directly revealing stage bottlenecks (high density, low velocity v_flow) and silent drop-off sinks h_drop(z, t)

scaleInvariants: O(1) constant-memory recursive state estimation per journey (fixed 16-float state vector + sufficient statistics) scaling linearly to 5,000,000+ streaming events per second
Time-scale invariance across millisecond A2A spans, minute-scale voice queues, and multi-day asynchronous messaging pauses via continuous-time hazard integration
Fokker-Planck density aggregation eliminates O(N^2) pairwise trace alignment, computing cohort-wide conformance and bottleneck fields in single-pass streaming reductions
